about: The secreta of the formulary “Second Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the holy oblation ever bring us, O Lord, a saving blessing, that what it performeth in mystery it may accomplish by its power. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
